newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong bank stocks gently firmer in thin London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong bank stocks gently firmer in thin London.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were mostly stuck in narrow ranges in becalmed trading here although slightly firmer bank stocks helped market indices edge higher, dealers said.
"The bank moves were on the back of the FTSE," said one trader at British bank.
At 1415 GMT, HSBC was up 2.5 pence at 1540p bid.
The Hang Seng London reference index was up 17.47 points, or 0.14 percent, to 12,598.32.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index lost 45.19 points, or 0.36 percent, to close at 12,580.85.
